$comment: Ownership map for {{name}}: one entry per product area an AI product manager owns. The key is the area; `label` must be `pm:<key>`; `paths` are prefixes inside the target repo; `metric` identifies a product outcome, event, or route; `schedule` is a 5-field cron in UTC. Optional `charter` fields hold owner ambition, goal, metricDefinition, users, expectedToBuild, nonGoals, guardrails, and standingPriorities. Learned discovery notes stay separate. Configure the Linear project before patrols; repository discovery can run first.
